primary_original.author: William Lilly
primary_original.work: Christian Astrology, third book, chapter CVII
primary_original.source_read_mode: Direct original first-print facsimile p535–536; other original printed planet-orb and fortitude pages earlier inspected independently. No manuscript-critical curation of every historical transmission.

source_adjudication.original_claim: S2 applies only if no qualifying planet is posited in the Ascendant
source_adjudication.implementation: Source S1 empty under each of three independent historical original place reconstructions

source_adjudication.original_claim: Planet joined to Moon or Mercury can signify manners
source_adjudication.implementation: All seven traditional bodies eligible under explicit broad alternative; narrow Venus/Mars/Jupiter/Saturn alternative independently computed; only mathematically qualified S2 candidates may be scored

source_adjudication.original_claim: A planet joined to both Moon and Mercury deserves explicit treatment
source_adjudication.implementation: Dual reference membership retained and never automatically given bonus or priority

source_adjudication.original_claim: If many planets signify manners, the strongest continues longest
source_adjudication.implementation: Several joined candidates retained as original source participants; strict partial maximum is a researcher diagnostic, not a historically valid unique governor

source_adjudication.original_claim: Historical orb moieties are supplied in p107 but p536 has no uniquely specified numeric orb choice
source_adjudication.implementation: Two published 1647 printed orb-envelope alternatives remain separate; conjunction shortest longitudinal separation ≤ half sum of planet orbs; independent Greek planetary latitude condition NOT silently imported from Ptolemy I.24

strict_method: When exactly one joined eligible planet, provisional sole S2 candidate regardless of unknown sect and near-station magnitude. If several eligible, choose a conditional partial-strength body only when its lower bounded essential+house+motion source-point score strictly exceeds every other eligible joined planet's upper score with known sect. Unknown near-station direct/retro grade [-5,+4], not zero. If no eligible S2, proceed to S3.
unmodeled_conditions: Original p535 secondary dignity-bearing nonoccupants, S1 luminary special treatment
Original p536 exact historical orb and broader Sun/Moon/Mercury joining eligibility

All Lilly p115 accidental strength conditions beyond three partial point families: stationary/speed, oriental, fixed stars, benefic/malefic aspects, combust/beams, nodes and reception actual matter-significator eligibility
Original simultaneous Moon/Mercury joined candidate special historical priority and appropriate source-relative fortification
Full ordered S3 dispositor, SX third case, S4 forceful partile, S5 Mercury/Moon-place dignity
Ptolemy original III.13 fifth phase/aspect and opposite testimony
Any independently validated psychological or trait claim and a unique #1 natal chart
